name: Content Access by Path
description: Restricts editing to site sections by path.
project_description:
This module allows you to set restrictions - by path - on what parts of your website users can edit. E.g. allow person X edit all content inside /news or inside /news/sports or inside /news/sports/rugby .

 As well as being able to edit content within those allowed paths, editors will also be able to edit content they are the author of. This is by design.

 Features 
 The main feature is that it does not restrict content editing access to specific nodes, but to paths, so all content from within that path.
